¿Quién reparte primero? Al empezar la pa: Who deals first? When the game starts everyone shakes the dice cup at once: the highest die takes the dealer button. If there's a tie at the top, only the tied players shake again. The host can change this in More settings.
Al vencer el tiempo elegido pasas si pue: When your time runs out you check if you can, or fold. If you lose your connection, you fold that hand unless you're already all-in. Whoever arrives mid-hand waits for the next one.
Con recompras, la siguiente mano repone: With rebuys, the next hand restores the starting stack to anyone at zero. Without rebuys, you watch until the host changes the settings. In fixed limit there are up to four bets per street; on the turn and river the bet doubles.
